A1.justification: Both PDFs are readable and describe the same HypeVPR work. However, neither includes the cited supplementary sections and figures covering dataset/metric details, Klein geometry, sub-tree partitioning and additional examples. Those materials cannot be compared; the judgments below concern the supplied content.

before.justification: Tables 1–4 report original HypeVPR benchmark results, retrieval efficiency measurements, and geometry and loss ablations.

after.justification: The paper retains original evaluations on YQ360 and Pitts250K-P2E and the ablations, with revised comparisons in Tables 1–2.

M1.justification: The shared backbone, level-wise GeM pooling, hyperbolic mapping and averaging, hierarchical reranking, and three triplet losses are retained. Rewritten explanations and simplified averaging notation do not establish a changed algorithm.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate P2E recognition on YQ360 and Pitts250K-P2E, including the same setting using pretrained EigenPlace. No additional dataset, task or test environment is reported.

E2.justification: Table 1 adds standalone SwinT and ConvNeXtS comparator rows on both datasets. Table 2 retains the same SALAD, EigenPlace, CosPlace and ConvAP comparisons.

E3.justification: Table 1 revises NetVLAD's reported parameter count from 7.23M to 25.3M and drops R@20 reporting, while the ablation tables retain R@20. HypeVPR's stated training and retrieval settings remain unchanged. The PDFs do not establish whether the parameter revision reflects a different model or a correction.

E4.justification: Table 1 removes the without-reranking configurations across both backbone families and window counts, reducing evidence isolating reranking's contribution. Table 2 retains its hierarchy trade-off comparison, and Tables 3–4 and Figure 4 retain the geometry ablation, loss ablations and qualitative examples.

E5.justification: Neither supplied PDF reports repeated-run counts, seeds, confidence intervals, error bars or significance tests. Results remain point estimates.

E6.justification: Table 1 revises YQ360 SwinT×8 recall from 32.0/69.6/84.4 to 38.0/74.4/88.0, adds backbone-baseline results and removes without-reranking and R@20 entries. Numerous timings change substantially: Orhan on Pitts250K-P2E changes from 9830.4 to 1555.2 ms; Table 2 changes SALAD from 1196.8 to 371.4 ms and EigenPlace from 214.5 to 90.5 ms. These are unexplained reporting revisions, not established same-setting acceleration. Tables 3–4 are unchanged.

T1.justification: v2 removes the explicit Poincaré-ball manifold and metric definitions, conformal-factor definition, and arccosh distance expression from v1's Preliminaries and Equations 1–2. The conformal factor still appears in the retained maps. The remaining mathematical machinery is essentially unchanged, with no new proofs.

C1.justification: The central hierarchical hyperbolic P2E framework and efficiency claims remain. v2 removes the explicit first-without-sliding-windows novelty claim and the abstract's quantified 'up to 5×' claim. Its contribution list replaces the named-dataset state-of-the-art claim with broader performance and generality wording.

C2.justification: v2 adds explicit mobile/edge-deployment suitability and emphasizes redundant window storage as motivation. It removes v1 Section 4.6's qualification that one descriptor struggles to handle all viewing angles. Interpretations of the retained geometry and loss ablations remain unchanged.

D1.justification: v1's future promise to release code and models becomes a code-only access label; actual resource availability cannot be verified from the PDFs. v2 explicitly extends the matching-only timing explanation to the reported tables. The principal training hyperparameters and implementation settings are retained.

R1.justification: v2 removes references to Choi et al. (2010), Parikh and Chen (2007), and Taunk et al. (2019). Positioning emphasizes panoramic hierarchy and redundant descriptors while dropping the explicit first-without-sliding-windows claim. Author-year formatting and the corrected Shi attribution do not introduce new cited works.

P1.justification: The introduction, related work, method overview, aggregation explanation and conclusion undergo extensive rewriting and condensation. The separate Network Design subsection is integrated into hierarchical modeling, and numbered sections and numerical citations become unnumbered headings and author-year citations.

P2.justification: Table 1 is redesigned from two dataset panels into one combined comparison; Table 2 reorders columns and rows and adds relative timing/storage ratios. The document is extensively reformatted, Figures 2–3 exchange numbering and placement, and Figure 4 moves. The underlying figure artwork is retained.

improvement.justification: Added backbone baselines and clearer tables help, but revised Table 2 timings invalidate retained speedup claims: the stated over 8×, over 5× and over 100× now correspond to approximately 5.1×, 2.2× and 60.9×. Removing the P2E without-reranking comparisons and the conformal-factor definition also reduces evidential coverage and mathematical self-containment. These shortcomings produce a limited net decline despite the presentation improvements.
